newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen losing 1.0 pct on U.S. fall.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen losing 1.0 pct on U.S. fall.

text.p: The latest falls on Wall Street were seen pushing the Danish KFX share index down by around one percent during the course of the day, dealers said on Thursday.

"Even though the Danish market managed quite well after the sharp American price fall over Easter, it will be hard to avoid a (Danish) fall on Thursday, especially in the light of declines on the German after-market on Wednesday," a dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.05 point -- 0.03 percent -- up on Wednesday compared to Tuesday.
